**Cause Management & Escalation**
#3759 introduces a default park ladder for spent shared causes, using a new diagnosis brief with prior attempts and emitting a single file cause ticket without operator escalation. #3515 re-binds acceptance criteria to specific tests and data files, re-scoping requirements to match executed plans.

**Data Integrity & Projections**
#3224 fixes a projection issue where declared key columns missing from relations caused 503 errors by keying reads only on live columns. #1805 adds a source option to the work-ledger CLI, supporting projection, local, or auto-fold modes with local-tail fallbacks. #3682 adds PR-state schema v2 with per-check facts and a webhook red-check path.

**Validation & Security Gates**
#1889 converts validators to canonical check-compute nodes, emitting validation reports and switching pre-commit hooks. #1821 widens the URL Authority Gate to detect DSN reads via AST, including environment variables and constants. #1837 adds a structural direct-model-call gate that refuses HTTP requests to model endpoints and unsanctioned SDK imports. #1953 retires the skip-token approvals registry, causing the receipt gate to reject all skip tokens.

**CI & Workflow Optimization**
#1392 removes merge_group triggers from 22 non-required workflows to save runner slots. #1395 removes 7 duplicate jobs from the omni-standards-compliance workflow. #1394 fixes false-green results in three validator gates by ensuring full-tree scans. #354 adds a call-repo-evidence-gate workflow for shadow counting.

**SPI & Protocol Updates**
#87 implements ProtocolNodeProjectionEffect for synchronous projection writes. #310 adds an optional delivery context to the dispatch protocol. #329 and #1119 update dependencies for OmniNode-ai/omniclaude and onex_change_control. #245 bumps actions/cache.

**Model & Runtime Features**
#3141 adds a free glm-4.5-flash rung on z.ai's API as a cheap cloud option. #2965 allows declaring machine runtime lanes via onex local init. #1796 fixes the canonical handler shape classifier to resolve inherited handle() methods. #3041 carries ticket IDs in delegate-skill terminals. #1918 lazy-loads package inits to reduce import time.

**Testing & Documentation**
#1234 adds protocol-conformance tests and fixes portable baseline paths. #1583 types the environment dependency convention. #1702 releases omnibase_core 0.47.17. #2988 adds a classify_head_checks seam with a labelled check-run corpus. #3155 removes dead mypy overrides. #2977 re-mints conflicting OCC companions.
